page.title: Tailwind CSS - Rapidly build modern websites without ever leaving your HTML.

captureWarnings.message: Fixed/sticky elements are omitted to avoid scroll-dependent document coordinates.
Nonuniform or unsupported borders were omitted.
Unsupported computed text color uses opaque black.
Wrapped/bidirectional text uses one axis-aligned union box per DOM text run; line fragments are not reconstructed.
Explicit z-index/flex order may differ from captured DOM child order; stacking contexts are not reconstructed.
Multiple, inset or malformed box shadows are omitted; only one outer shadow is supported.
Text uses original characters; CSS text-transform is not applied.
Browser-rendered axis-aligned boxes are captured; rotation/skew/scale semantics are not preserved.
Image is unavailable, unloaded or broken; only an empty box placeholder is captured.
W2D-005: rendered light-DOM boxes, editable text, basic styles, images and inline SVG. Pseudo-elements, clipping, full paint order, media and advanced layout/style semantics are not reconstructed.
